title: Hazie WhatsApp n'enweghị nsogbu wee kpọchie akaụntụ gị

say: Hazie WhatsApp n'enweghị nsogbu, wee kpọchie akaụntụ gị.
Nke a bụ vidiyo maka modul nke WhatsApp maka nkwukọrịta na azụmaahịa.
Ejikọ akaụntụ WhatsApp gị na otu nọmba ekwentị. Nọmba ahụ na-aghọ njirimara gị, yabụ họrọ ahịrị ị na-eme atụmatụ idobe ruo ọtụtụ afọ.
Mbụ, wụnye ezigbo ngwa, ọ dịghị ihe ọzọ.

Debe ya emelitere maka ndozi nchekwa.

say: Awụnyela oyiri gafere dị ka faịlụ, dị ka GB WhatsApp. Ọ bụghị WhatsApp mere ha, ha nwere ike izu ohi ozi gị, WhatsApp nwekwara ike machibido akaụntụ ndị na-eji ha.
Ọ bụrụ na ị nwere otu, kwadoo ihe ịchọrọ, wepụ ya, ma wụnye ngwa ọrụ.

say: Nnwale nke nzọụkwụ abụọ na-agbakwunye PIN ọnụọgụ isii nke ị mepụtara. Mgbe ahụ onye ọ bụla na-agbalị ịdenye nọmba gị na ekwentị ọhụrụ chọrọ koodu SMS na PIN gị.
Nzọụkwụ nke mbụ. Mepee Ntọala, wee Akaụntụ, wee kwenye nkwenye nzọụkwụ abụọ.

panel.rule: Ekekọrịtala onye ọ bụla koodu SMS ma ọ bụ PIN gị, mgbe ọ bụla.

say: Nke a bụ ka aghụghọ ahụ si arụ ọrụ. Chioma na Owerri na-ere ngwaahịa ntutu. Otu mgbede ozi si na akaụntụ nwa nwanne nna ya bịa.
Ọ na-ekwu, ezitere m koodu m na nọmba gị, biko zitere m ya.

panel.heading: A nso miss: koodu aghụghọ
items: Ozi sitere na akaụntụ nwa nwanne nna ya na-arịọ maka koodu
Koodu SMS na-abịa n'otu oge
Ọ dịghị ezipụ ya; ọ na-akpọ nwa nwanne nna ya
Ọ na-agbanye nkwenye nzọụkwụ abụọ

say: N'otu oge ahụ, SMS nwere koodu ọnụọgụ isii na-abịarute. Chioma matara ụkpụrụ ahụ. Otu onye na-achọ ịdebanye aha nọmba ya na ekwentị ọzọ, ma eleghị anya a tọọrọla akaụntụ nwa nwanne nna ya.

say: Ugbu a bulie ekwentị gị. Lelee ngwa gị bụ nke arụnyere na emelitere, mee nyocha nzuzo, gbanye nkwenye nzọụkwụ abụọ, wee mee otu nkwado ndabere na mpaghara Wi-Fi.
Were nseta ihuenyo na-egosi nkwenye nzọụkwụ abụọ dị, na-enweghị PIN, wee gaa n'ihu na nkuzi dị n'okpuru.
